description: Long-running daemon. Every 1800s, paginates the npm public search API at https://registry.npmjs.com/-/v1/search?text=keywords:modelcontextprotocol&size=100&from=<offset> AND ALSO https://registry.npmjs.com/-/v1/search?text=mcp-server&size=100&from=<offset> (two queries per cycle, alternating to widen coverage). Sets User-Agent 'zo-sentinel/1.0 (mcp-trust-intelligence)' and Accept 'application/json' on every request. Tracks per-query offset cursors in /home/workspace/zo_sentinel/state/npm_pagination_cursor.json with shape {"keywords_modelcontextprotocol": int, "mcp-server": int, "updated_at": iso}. On each cycle, advances the cursor of whichever query is due next (round-robin), fetches one page, parses response.objects[].package fields {name, description, keywords, links.npm, date}. Filters: KEEP if EITHER (keywords contains 'modelcontextprotocol' or 'model-context-protocol' or 'mcp') OR (name starts with 'mcp-' or '@modelcontextprotocol/' or contains '-mcp-' or ends with '-mcp') OR (description case-insensitive contains 'model context protocol' or 'mcp server'). For each kept package, ws_write to mcp_discovery_candidates with row {candidate_name=name, candidate_url='https://www.npmjs.com/package/'+name, candidate_description=(description or '')[:500], discovered_in_directory='npm_search', discovered_status='active', last_seen=now, promoted=FALSE}. Schema note: mcp_discovery_candidates UNIQUE constraint is on (discovered_in_directory, candidate_name); WriteService should handle upsert via ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE SET last_seen=now (verify by reading mcp_discovery_candidates schema via /query SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='mcp_discovery_candidates' AND ordinal_position<=20 BEFORE first write so the row shape matches). Heartbeat thread every 30s writing service_health row {service='discovery_npm_paginator', last_heartbeat=ISO}. Single-instance lockfile at /home/workspace/logs/discovery_npm_paginator.lock with stale-PID-reclaim semantics matching candidate_promoter_daemon.py. Imports requests, json, datetime, threading, time, os, sys, pathlib, hashlib only. NO duckdb, NO sqlite3, NO project imports. Polite inter-fetch sleep 500ms. Exits cleanly on SIGTERM. Logs structured INFO line per cycle: 'cycle done query=<q> page=<n> seen=<x> kept=<y> written=<z> errors=<e>'. When npm returns response.total and offset+size >= total, resets that query's cursor to 0 (re-walks). Fetch timeout 10s; on requests exception, log warning and skip cycle, do NOT advance cursor. CRITICAL: NEVER write to mcp_server_registry; this module is discovery-only. The existing candidate_npm_promoter.py picks up rows where candidate_url LIKE '%npmjs.com/package/%' and promotes them.
